entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Setting up and maintenance of genealogical registers of animal breeds; Determination of the genetic quality of animals. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and points 40, 41 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.
